title: Jacobabad Institute of Medical Sciences Amendment Act 2018

sections.shortTitle: Jacobabad Institute of Medical Sciences Amendment Act 2018
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT III OF 2018
ACT III OF 2018
JACOBABAD INSTITUTE OF MEDICAL SCIENCES (AMENDMENT)
ACT, 2018
An Act to amend the Jacobabad Institute of Medical Sciences Act, 2013
[Gazette of Sindh Extraordinary, Part IV, 2nd January, 2018]
No.PAS/LEGIS-B-30/2017,
dated 2.1.2018.---The Jacobabad
Institute of Medical Sciences (Amendment) Bill, 2017 having been passed by the
Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 23rd November, 2017 and assented to by the
Governor of Sindh on 26th December, 2017 is hereby published as an Act of the
Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.---WHEREAS it is expedient to amend the Jacobabad
Institute of Medical Sciences Act, 2013, in the matter hereinafter appearing.
It
is hereby enacted as follows:-
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This
Act may be called the Jacobabad Institute of Medical Sciences (Amendment) Act,
2017.
(2) It
shall come into force at once.

No.PAS/LEGIS-B-30/2017,
dated 2.1.2018.---The Jacobabad
Institute of Medical Sciences (Amendment) Bill, 2017 having been passed by the
Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 23rd November, 2017 and assented to by the
Governor of Sindh on 26th December, 2017 is hereby published as an Act of the
Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.---WHEREAS it is expedient to amend the Jacobabad
Institute of Medical Sciences Act, 2013, in the matter hereinafter appearing.
It
is hereby enacted as follows:-
2. Amendment
of section 8 of Sindh Act No. XIX of 2013.---In the said Act, in section 8, for subsection (1), the following shall
be substituted-
"(1) The general direction and administration of the institute and its
affairs shall vest in the Board consisting of the following-
(i)
Minister Health or if
there is no Minister Health, Member of Cabinet nominated by the Chief
Minister
Chairman
(ii)
Member of Provincial
Assembly of the Constituency where the institute is located
Member
(iii)
Secretary Health
Member
(iv)
Commissioner of
Division or in his absence the Deputy Commissioner Jacobabad
Member
(v)
A Professional having
substantial contribution to the field of Medical Sciences recognized
nationally and internationally (nominated by the Chief Minister)
Member
(vi)
Officer commanding or
his representative of Pakistan Air Force Shahbaz Base Jacobabad, not below
the rank of group-Captain
Member
(vii)
One reputed citizen
from the adjacent area of Jacobabad (nominated by the Chief Minister)
Member
(viii)
Chairman, District
Council Jacobabad
Member
(ix)
One representative of
US AID
Member
(x)
One nominee of
Academic Council
Member
(xi)
Director of the
Institute
Member/ Secretary
